name: cmdb_view
label: CMDB View Table
description: The CMDB view is designed for querying related association queries and reporting scenarios related to configuration management.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Model ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: item_id
fields.description: Relationship_or_attribute_id, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ci_id, item_id, type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_item_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the item_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
